fullDescription: A high-performance dark-themed logistics marketplace style. Features a sophisticated deep navy aesthetic with vibrant blue and emerald accents, utilizing glassmorphism, 3D interactive transforms, and scroll-triggered animations. Optimized for industrial SaaS, fintech dashboards, or transport logistics platforms requiring a professional yet cutting-edge 'future-tech' feel. Key design elements include editorial typography (Cabinet Grotesk), carbon-fiber textured backgrounds, and high-gloss 3D card components with shimmer effects.

structured.summary: A modern, industrial dark-mode interface for a logistics marketplace. It combines a dynamic animated gradient background with glassmorphism UI elements. The design leverages 3D perspective transforms on hover and smooth reveal-on-scroll animations to create an immersive, premium user experience suitable for high-end B2B platforms.

style.description: Industrial Dark Mode with Glassmorphism and 3D Interaction. Typography uses heavy-weight headings (Cabinet Grotesk) paired with geometric sans-serif body text (Satoshi). Color palette centers on Deep Navy (#050811), Electric Blue (#2563EB), and WhatsApp Green (#22C55E). Animations include 15s looping gradient backgrounds and cubic-bezier (0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) transforms for 3D interactions.
style.prompt: Create a design system with a background of `#050811` featuring a subtle carbon-fibre texture overlay at 20% opacity and a slow-moving linear gradient animation between `#050811`, `#1e3a8a`, and `#172554`. **Typography**: Headings in 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Extrabold, 800), Body in 'Satoshi' (Regular 400, Bold 700). **Glassmorphism**: Components use `background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03)`, `backdrop-filter: blur(12px)`, and a border of `1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)`. **Accents**: Primary buttons in `#2563EB` with a glow shadow `0 10px 30px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3)`; Success elements in `#22C55E`. **Interactive**: All cards must sit in a `perspective: 1000px` container and utilize `transform-style: preserve-3d` for mouse-tracking rotation. Transitions should use `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)` for reveal effects.

layout_and_structure.description: The layout follows a structured landing page format with a centered high-impact hero, a grid-based product marketplace, and a dual-column feature section with a dashboard preview.

prompts.prompt: Fixed navigation bar using a glassmorphism container. Max-width 7xl. Left: Logo with a `#2563EB` square icon box. Center: Horizontal nav links in `#94A3B8` (hover to white). Right: High-contrast CTA button 'List Your Asset' with white background and black text, transforming to blue on hover.

Top-aligned section with a centered badge: 'Pakistan's fastest Logistics Marketplace' in `#60A5FA` with 10% opacity background. Headline: 72px Cabinet Grotesk with a gradient span (Blue-400 to Emerald-400). Beneath headline, a large 3-part glassmorphism search bar with 'Pickup', 'Destination', and a blue 'Search Leads' button. Apply 3D perspective to the search bar container.

3-column grid of 3D-interactive cards. Each card: 2.5rem corner radius, glassmorphism border, 4/3 aspect ratio image at top with floating status badges (e.g., 'AVAILABLE' in Emerald, 'BUSY' in Gray). Content includes 2x2 data grid for specs, a primary WhatsApp button in `#22C55E`, and a secondary 'Direct Call' glass button. Include a 'shimmer' animation overlay on the card face.

A large 3rem radius glass container. Left side: Marketing copy with emerald checkmarks. Right side: A decorative 'floating' dashboard preview tilted at 3-degrees. Dashboard contains small data widgets (Total Inquiries, Clicks, Active Assets) with mini-graphs and progress indicators.

Darker background `#000000/50` with a top border of `white/5`. Three-column layout: Brand info, text links (Terms, Privacy), and social icons in circular glass buttons. Bottom copyright section centered with 12px text.

special_ui_components.description: A high-depth card that tilts towards the user's cursor.
special_ui_components.prompt: Card container with `perspective: 1000px`. The inner card uses `transform-style: preserve-3d` and a transition of `0.5s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)`. On mousemove, calculate `rotateX` and `rotateY` based on cursor offset from card center (range +/- 10deg). The card features a constant `shimmer` animation: a 45-degree linear gradient moving from left -50% to 150% every 6 seconds.

special_ui_components.description: Small, high-visibility indicator used on images.
special_ui_components.prompt: Positioned absolute on card images. `font-size: 10px`, `font-weight: 900`, `letter-spacing: normal`. Padding `4px 12px`. Colors: `#10B981` (Success/Available) or `#3B82F6` (ID/Info). Rounded-full corners.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for all numbers and titles to maintain the industrial aesthetic. MUST: Implement the 3D hover effect using JavaScript to calculate mouse position relative to card center for realistic tilt. MUST NOT: Use solid backgrounds for cards; always maintain the 12px blur transparency. MUST NOT: Use standard system fonts; use Satoshi for all data-heavy UI components for readability.
